finding.claim: Unauthenticated SSRF: POST parameter 'feed' is passed directly to file_get_contents(), which accepts URLs (http, ftp, etc.) and local file paths and wrappers. No authentication, allowlist, scheme or host validation. Response length is echoed, giving a blind/side-channel oracle (size) for internal resources and enabling port/host scanning and cloud metadata probing.

trace.note: Branch entered for any POST with 'feed' set; no require_admin() call
User-supplied value passed to file_get_contents as URL
strlen of fetched body echoed back to attacker

finding.guards_checked: Checked for require_admin (defined at line 4 but not called on this path), scheme/host allowlist, private IP blocking, and allow_url_fopen checks: none present.

verdict.reason: import.php:11-13 passes $_POST['feed'] straight into file_get_contents() and echoes strlen of the result, with no require_admin() call (defined at lines 4-9, only used at line 18 on a different branch) and no scheme/host validation.

finding.claim: SSRF via admin-only webhook setting: 'set_webhook' value is passed to curl_init/curl_exec with no scheme, host, or IP validation, so an admin (or an attacker with a hijacked admin session) can make the server request internal hosts or metadata endpoints, and curl also allows non-HTTP schemes such as file://, gopher://. Response is not returned, so it is blind. Lower severity because it is gated by admin.
finding.guards_checked: require_admin() session check only; no URL scheme/host allowlist, no CURLOPT_PROTOCOLS restriction, no private-IP filtering, redirects not restricted.

verdict.guard_found: none (only the require_admin() session check at import.php:4-9 and :18, which is an authorization gate, not URL validation)
verdict.reason: The trace is accurate (import.php:17-22), but the source is not attacker-controlled: $_POST['set_webhook'] at import.php:19 is reachable only after require_admin() at import.php:18, so only an admin can set it. Under the verification rules an admin-only value does not count as a low-privilege attacker source.
